description: This file defines the HomeActivity widget for a Flutter app, implementing a main navigation shell with a Scaffold, AppBar, Drawer, and multiple fragments for different sections like Home, COVID-19, Payment, Rides, etc. It manages drawer state, user profile display, and navigation between fragments.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen with navigation drawer and fragments.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class managing drawer selection, app bar, and fragment display.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class for drawer menu items with icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeActivity.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes display name and email from widget properties or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body content based on selected drawer item.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on current drawer selection.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates selected drawer index and closes the drawer.
